annotation.title_clean: Commission Regulation (EU) 2017/1154 of 7 June 2017 amending Regulation (EU) 2017/1151 as regards real-driving emissions from light passenger and commercial vehicles (Euro 6)
annotation.title_en: Commission Regulation (EU) 2017/1154 of 7 June 2017 amending Regulation (EU) 2017/1151 as regards real-driving emissions from light passenger and commercial vehicles (Euro 6)
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 175
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Regulation amending the Euro 6 implementing rules to add cold-start, particle-number and hybrid-vehicle provisions to real-driving emissions testing, strengthen defeat-device oversight through extended documentation of emission strategies, and require declared maximum RDE values in certificates of conformity. Not about AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds cold-start and particle number (PN) evaluation to RDE type-approval testing
Requires an extended confidential documentation package on auxiliary emission strategies to police defeat devices
Manufacturers must declare maximum RDE NOx and PN values in the certificate of conformity and publish PEMS results online
Small-volume manufacturers get extra time; ultra-small-volume manufacturers are exempt
Commission to develop a revised evaluation method for hybrid and plug-in hybrid vehicles
